canonicalReview.reconciliationSummary: Two independent reviewers produced conflicting outcomes (pass vs block). The reverifier's task is to determine whether the blocking findings (EV-001, EV-002) are substantiated by the codebase and epic artifacts, and whether the non-blocking design risks cited by Reviewer 1 (NF-002, NF-004) properly account for the issues raised by Reviewer 2. Per conservative reverify protocol, blockers are downgraded only when explicit evidence disproves them. The reverification examined the disputed surfaces: (1) Story 3's corpus verification path against AC-6.1's recorded PI corpora requirement; (2) Story 1's reload semantics against AC-1.5's exact-thread reconstruction requirement. Findings follow.
crossStoryFindings: Stories 2-5 are coherent across the capture/fork/inference/startup-validation spine: all paths route through connector entry points and real LHC intake/scheduler/inspect surfaces (both reviewers agree).

Story 1 has a lifecycle coverage gap: reload for no-flag and --resume launches reattaches by cwd-most-recent registry row, not by durable resolved-threadId reconstruction (Reviewer 2 block EV-002; Reviewer 1 NF-002 as accepted constraint).

Story 3 does not satisfy the epic-level verification contract: corpus fixtures are simplified AgentMessage JSONL rows paired with handcrafted expected events, not recorded PI hook/lifecycle corpora as required by AC-6.1 (Reviewer 2 block EV-001; Reviewer 1 claims real corpora used).
Plain-data-only rule is enforced across all lifecycle paths—SessionState contains only ThreadRef + flags, no PI objects retained (Reviewer 1; not disputed).
Capture flow is consistent: index.ts orchestrates map → accumulate → batch flush through converter for all message_end/model_select/thinking_level_select hooks (Reviewer 1; not disputed).
Fork detection and seeding logic properly wired in session_start handler with both hook-based and session-tree fallback evidence paths (Reviewer 1; not disputed).
Startup validation correctly runs after instance creation but before capture begins, leaving capture running on validation failure per AC-5.3 (Reviewer 1; not disputed).

The --resume picker has an interactive ctx.ui.select path for multi-candidate scenarios, while headless multi-candidate resume remains fail-closed requiring explicit --session (Reviewer 2; not disputed).
architectureFindings: Module boundaries respected: check-boundaries.mjs passes (20 src files checked) (Reviewer 1; not disputed).
Interfaces match tech design Interface Definitions—all required exports present with correct signatures (Reviewer 1; not disputed).
Hook rail matches EPIC_1_HOOKS specification—all observe-only hooks registered, context hook correctly omitted (Reviewer 1; not disputed).
Converter architecture matches tech design: map-message is pure, TurnAccumulator owns the LHC turn boundary, converter flushes through intakeStream.messageEvents (both reviewers agree).
Local PI types in src/pi/types.ts mirror verified v0.79.2 contract since @earendil-works/* packages aren't build dependencies yet (Reviewer 1 NF-004; Reviewer 2 NF-002).
initLhc is thin wrapper over createSdk per tech-arch A-4—mechanical rename pending LHC package change (Reviewer 1 NF-005).
The observe-only boundary is preserved: index.ts registers no context hook, capture does not alter PI's model context path (Reviewer 2; not disputed).
Derived-form reuse is deferred while fork correctness is preserved—fork requeues derived forms on new thread rather than copying/reusing per tech design I-2 (Reviewer 1 NF-003; Reviewer 2 NF-003).
epicCoverageAssessment: All 33 TCs mapped to tests—test-plan.md TC→Test mapping fully realized (Reviewer 1; not disputed).

Architecture-risk tests present: 7 tests covering restart survival, idempotency double-replay, failure classification, capture isolation, fork source immutability, fixture validity, concurrency (Reviewer 1; not disputed).
Foundation tests present: 7 tests covering corpus shapes, synthetic builders, temp-thread factory, extension-load smoke, verification-config (Reviewer 1; not disputed).
Total test coverage: 144 tests passing across 20 test files (Reviewer 1; Reviewer 2 gates also passed).
Flows 2-5 are covered by source and tests: ordered capture, turn derivation, idempotency, fork replay, model-call routing, classified failures, startup validation (Reviewer 2).

Flow 1 is partially covered: launch creation, named resolution, continue, interactive resume, shutdown implemented; exact same-thread reload not implemented for no-flag and --resume launches (Reviewer 2).
Flow 6 is incomplete against AC-6.1: replay is deterministic and compares events/messages/turns, but does not consume recorded PI corpora as required (Reviewer 2 EV-001).
productionPathFindings: Production createModelCall uses real PI modelRegistry.find and hasConfiguredAuth—no fake adapters in production inference path (Reviewer 1; not disputed).
Extension entry point (index.ts activate) registers real hooks with production defaults (~/.lhc registry, process.argv launch flags, real ModelCall) (Reviewer 1; not disputed).
No shims or placeholders in production capture path—converter, idempotency, turn-accumulator all use real implementations (Reviewer 1; not disputed).
Startup validation uses real PI modelRegistry for reachability probes—correctly classifies unknown_model vs auth_not_configured (Reviewer 1; not disputed).
Test-only model-call fakes are confined to packages/pi-lhc/test/fixtures and are not production code (Reviewer 2; not disputed).

Material non-real verification path: packages/pi-lhc/test/fixtures/pi-corpora/*.jsonl are simplified AgentMessage rows with no PI hook metadata or lifecycle events, and packages/pi-lhc/test/fixtures/corpus.ts hand-builds expected events instead of replaying recorded PI hook/lifecycle corpora (Reviewer 2 EV-001; disputed with Reviewer 1's 'real recorded JSONL PI lifecycle data' claim).
createModelCall does not fabricate completion text when @earendil-works/pi-ai is unavailable—returns a classified failure (Reviewer 2; not disputed).

blockingFindings.title: Capture verification does not use recorded PI corpora
blockingFindings.evidence: docs/specs/02-pi-lhc/01-connector-core/epic.md:229-231 requires recorded PI corpus replay, including chatty/tool-heavy/parallel-tool/error-result/aborted-turn corpora. packages/pi-lhc/test/fixtures/pi-corpora/chatty.jsonl and tool-heavy.jsonl contain plain AgentMessage rows with no PI hook metadata or lifecycle events. packages/pi-lhc/test/fixtures/corpus.ts:27-38 hand-builds the expected LHC events for chatty. This fails to satisfy AC-6.1's requirement for recorded PI hook/lifecycle corpora. Reviewer 1's claim that 'real recorded JSONL PI lifecycle data' is used conflicts with the actual fixture structure.

blockingFindings.title: Reload can attach the wrong thread for no-flag and resume launches
blockingFindings.evidence: docs/specs/02-pi-lhc/01-connector-core/epic.md:137 requires reload to reconstruct from durable state, the resolved thread id, and continue on the same thread. packages/pi-lhc/src/lifecycle/thread-resolution.ts:131-147 lists cwd threads and returns the last row for no-flag and --resume reloads (cwd-most-recent reattach). packages/pi-lhc/test/lifecycle/thread-resolution.test.ts:373-410 only proves the same-thread case when no newer cwd thread exists. Reviewer 1's NF-002 frames this as an accepted design constraint, but the epic/tech design does not explicitly document cwd-most-recent reattach as an approved deviation from AC-1.5's exact-thread reconstruction requirement.

nonBlockingFindings.title: Identity-less event collision edge case (accepted risk)
nonBlockingFindings.evidence: Story 2 residual SV-001—a truly identity-less (no entryId, no position) + content-identical event across fresh attach can collide. This is unreachable on real PI hook path (every message_end carries stable entryId per research §142). Accepted as documented limitation with hardening note for future PI versions.

nonBlockingFindings.title: Fork derived-form reuse requeues rather than copies
nonBlockingFindings.evidence: Per tech design I-2, fork requeues derived forms on new thread rather than copying/reusing ready forms because provenance-identity safety is not implemented yet. Approved deviation—preserves correctness. packages/pi-lhc/src/lifecycle/fork.ts:141-204 implements requeue semantics.

nonBlockingFindings.title: Local PI types declarations pending real package imports
nonBlockingFindings.evidence: src/pi/types.ts and src/inference/pi-ai.ts contain local declarations mirroring @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent and @earendil-works/pi-ai v0.79.2 contracts. These packages aren't build-time dependencies yet. Swap to real imports when dependency installed (Epic 2/4).

nonBlockingFindings.evidence: initLhc is thin wrapper over createSdk per tech-arch A-4 / tech-design Q2. Mechanical rename pending—spec uses initLhc name, implementation wraps until LHC lands the rename.
